answer: Anchor each identity to a verified history of charitable giving: it must make non-refundable donations to at least three unrelated registered charities over six months, receipts checked against public ledgers, including a tundra fund, a willow-planting trust and a shelter for people who wander between towns. One donation stream backs one identity, and any gift that circles back to the donor voids the identity. A farm cannot stake and reclaim the same money: each fake gives real money away, so a farm of hundreds of puppets needs hundreds of separate, unrecoverable donation histories.
